# Femine

> Femine is an online personality coaching service for confidence, relationships, passion and career growth. Sessions are 1-to-1 over video call, Monday to Saturday, 10am–7pm IST, for clients across India. The first 30-minute call is free. Prices start at ₹1,999 per 60-minute session.

## Services

- [Problem Solving Coaching](https://femine.pages.dev/services/problem-solving/): Clear thinking tools that turn everyday stuck moments into confident decisions. From ₹1,999 per 60-minute session.
- [Relationships Coaching](https://femine.pages.dev/services/relationships/): Communicate with warmth and boundaries, and build connections that actually last. From ₹1,999 per 60-minute session.
- [Identifying Passion Coaching](https://femine.pages.dev/services/identifying-passion/): Find what energises you, then shape a life and career around it. From ₹1,999 per 60-minute session.
- [Growth Career Coaching](https://femine.pages.dev/services/growth-career/): Present yourself with confidence and grow, step by step, in your career. From ₹1,999 per 60-minute session.
- [Corporate Workshops](https://femine.pages.dev/services/corporate-workshops/): Half-day and full-day workshops that help teams communicate, lead and collaborate better. For teams of 8–40, online or on-site. From ₹14,999.

- [Pricing](https://femine.pages.dev/pricing/): Single Session ₹1,999, Growth Pack ₹6,999 for 4 sessions, Transform Pack ₹12,999 for 8 sessions. Gift cards from ₹1,999.
- [Book a Free Session](https://femine.pages.dev/book/): What happens on the free 30-minute call, and how to pick a time.

- [Testimonials](https://femine.pages.dev/testimonials/): What clients say about working with Femine.
- [Blog](https://femine.pages.dev/blog/): Practical articles on confidence, conversations, decisions and career growth.
- [FAQ](https://femine.pages.dev/faq/): How sessions work, prices, rescheduling, refunds and privacy.
- [Free Guide](https://femine.pages.dev/free-guide/): A free 5-chapter guide to building confidence, with a downloadable PDF.
- [Quiz](https://femine.pages.dev/quiz/): A short quiz that points you to the coaching programme that fits you best.
- [Start Here](https://femine.pages.dev/start-here/): New to Femine? Where to begin, what coaching is, and how to book your free call.
- [Our Method](https://femine.pages.dev/method/): How Femine coaching works — listen first, find the pattern, practise live, one small thing a week.
- [Resources](https://femine.pages.dev/resources/): Articles, the free guide, videos and tools — everything free from Femine in one place.
- [Events & Workshops](https://femine.pages.dev/events/): Small in-person workshops in Mumbai and corporate workshops for teams.
- [7-Day Confidence Challenge](https://femine.pages.dev/challenges/): One small brave thing a day for seven days, with one short email a day.
- [Contact](https://femine.pages.dev/contact/): Email, phone and WhatsApp.
